corner_asymmetry.note: excess over 1.00 is non-radial: decentering (repeats across sets, same darkest corner) or a baked sky gradient (moves). WARN threshold 1.20 is PROVISIONAL from the measured corpus (july23 1.126/1.159/1.229/1.320, july27 set-01 1.332) — it flags for attention, it does not gate.

gate: smooth falloff (corners < centre), NO structured sky residual (MW band / IFN clumps) on the preview, speck count ~0; the eye check + the with/without finals comparison gate adoption (dead-end registry: a sky flat is dust-safe only when validated)
